audit.root_cause: The hub has no built wheel for this env (wheel_url null), and the hub's install index for this env returns no distribution of frozen-lake, so the package cannot be resolved at all. This looks hub-side, and the verifiers pin is not the cause.
audit.evidence: details/antim__frozen_lake.json: `wheel_url: null`, only an sdist (`original_filename: frozen_lake-0.1.3.tar.gz`); install.log: `Because frozen-lake was not found in the package registry and you require frozen-lake==0.1.3`. The same failure hits sibling no-wheel envs antim__blackjack, antim__taxi, sboesen__aime2025, semih__uq_project and tonyteo__wordle. The source itself (frozen_lake.py plus a valid hatch include) looks buildable.
audit.irl_fix: Republish (`prime env push`) so the hub builds and serves a wheel. Confirm whether `prime env install` falls back to the sdist/package_url; we did not check this.
